name: mbse-agents
description: Investigate system behavior, compare designs, and review requirements, interfaces, and verification evidence.

interface.shortDescription: Trace system decisions to their engineering evidence
interface.longDescription: Use the project baseline to explain system behavior, compare concepts, connect requirements to architecture, or check whether verification results support a change decision.
defaultPrompt: Trace this outage through our interfaces. Check plausible causes against the logs and say what observation could settle it.
Compare these baseline revisions. Cite the affected requirements and show which earlier tests still cover the changed behavior.
